newsitem.title: USA: Littlefield says at impasse with Blumenfeld.
newsitem.headline: Littlefield says at impasse with Blumenfeld.

text.p: Littlefield Adams and Co said Monday it was unable to reach an agreement on any possible transactions with Michael Blumenfeld and was doubtful that the discussions would continue.
Separately, Littlefield said it had renewed and extended its financing agreements with Merchant Factors Corp through December 31, 1998 on the same terms as existing agreements.

The company said in a statement that it had on June 5 ended discussions on Blumenfeld investing up to $1 million and acquiring management control, but said it was continuing to discuss other transactions.
